Deadline & Action Timeline · FY2027 Pied-à-Terre Surcharge

NYC pied-à-terre surcharge appeal deadlines

Find the Class 2 and Class 1 TC107 deadlines, including the separate timing for a final DOF residency decision.

Mark the date for your tax class

  • March 1, 2027 for Tax Class 2.
  • March 15, 2027 for Tax Class 1.

The Tax Commission lists these deadlines for 2026–27 and 2027–28 market-value challenges and for applications that also challenge the initial residency determination. Read the official TC107 instructions for the deadline that applies to your notice.

If you first challenged residency with DOF

For an appeal of DOF’s final residency decision, the deadline is the later of the applicable March date or 30 days from the date of the final determination notice. Market-value appeals still need to meet the applicable March date.

If you missed October 13

The city’s 2026–27 administrative exemption application deadline was October 13, 2026. The Tax Commission instructions explain how it handles residency and market-value challenges. Use the determination on your notice and the official instructions to check which route applies.

Send the signed application on paper

The Tax Commission must receive Form TC107 by the applicable deadline. The instructions give a separate 30-day window for sending additional materials using Form TC159. Supporting documents may be emailed.
